sections.overview: Altostrat is a major media company with a large library of audio and video assets, including podcasts, interviews, news segments, and documentaries. Serving a broad and varied audience with premium content depends on a content management system that can keep up with a fast-moving media market.
sections.solutionConcept: Altostrat aims to modernize content management and audience engagement with Google Cloud generative AI. The desired platform should offer personalized recommendations, natural-language interaction, and self-service support, while also growing revenue via dynamic pricing, targeted marketing, and tailored product suggestions. Embedding AI tooling into their existing Google Cloud setup is meant to streamline management of the media library, improve the user experience, open new revenue streams, and reinforce their position as a media leader.
sections.existingTech:
- Content management and delivery platform runs on **GKE** for scale and high availability across a large media library.
- The media library (documents plus various audio and video formats) is held in **Cloud Storage**.
- **BigQuery** is the main data warehouse, used to analyze user behavior, consumption patterns, and audience demographics.
- **Cloud Run functions** handle serverless, event-driven jobs such as video transcoding, metadata extraction, and recommendation generation.
- Some **legacy on-premises systems** remain for workflows like content ingestion and archival; these are planned for future modernization and migration to Google Cloud.
- Identity and authentication use a mix of **Google Identity and third-party identity providers**.
- Observability combines native tools like **Cloud Monitoring** with open source **Prometheus**, with alerts mostly sent by email.
businessReqs: Make operational workflows faster and more reliable across both Google Cloud and on-premises environments.
Simplify infrastructure management to enable rapid application deployment.
Reduce cloud storage costs while keeping media content highly available and scalable.
Provide natural-language interaction with the platform alongside 24/7 user support.
Automatically produce concise summaries of media content.
Extract rich metadata from media assets using NLP and computer vision.
Detect and filter out inappropriate content.
Analyze media to surface trends and actionable insights.
Use data to guide content strategy and decision-making.
technicalReqs: Modernize CI/CD for containerized deployments with a centralized management platform.
Establish secure, high-performance hybrid cloud connectivity for data ingestion.
Run scalable, performant Kubernetes environments both on-premises and in the cloud.
Optimize cloud storage costs as media volumes grow.
Design AI-driven detection of harmful content.
Keep AI systems auditable with explainable decisions.
Use LLMs and conversational AI to drive personalized experiences and content virality.
Build advanced chatbots with natural language understanding for personalized assistance.
Provide automated summarization across diverse media types.
sections.executiveStatement: Altostrat is embracing generative AI to transform its content strategy, giving its audience intelligent tools for discovery, personalized recommendations, and smooth interaction. Reliability and cost control are top priorities, and this initiative is expected to deepen engagement, build loyalty, and open new revenue through targeted marketing and tailored content offerings.
